body:
### Problem

When I type in a buffer with code lenses, Neovim requests `codeLens/resolve` for every visible lens after each pause in typing, and the next edit makes those requests stale. Since #38153, Neovim ignores the stale responses, but it doesn't cancel the requests, so the server keeps working on all of them. With LuaLS, each resolve is a workspace-wide reference search ("Searching in files..."), and typing one line leaves 100+ of them running in parallel, which slows everything down.

Neovim already cancels stale in-flight requests for semantic tokens, pull diagnostics, and completion. LuaLS honors `$/cancelRequest`: cancelling the stale resolves on each edit makes the problem go away.

### Steps to reproduce using "nvim --clean -u minimal_init.lua"

1. Generate the project and start Neovim:

   ```sh
   nvim -l gen.lua
   nvim -u init.lua project/main.lua
   ```

2. Wait until LuaLS has loaded the workspace and the lenses show "1 references".
3. Open a line (`22Go`) and type `local foo = 123` at a normal pace (~4 keys per second).
4. Watch the statusline and the "Searching in files..." progress messages.
5. Repeat with `CANCEL=1 nvim -u init.lua project/main.lua`.

> [!NOTE]
> If your PC is too powerful to see the slow down after typing, increase the module count in `gen.lua`.

```lua
-- init.lua
-- Usage: `nvim -u init.lua project/main.lua`, or `CANCEL=1 nvim -u init.lua project/main.lua`
local CANCEL = vim.env.CANCEL == "1" -- cancel codeLens/resolve requests that an edit made stale

local root = vim.fn.fnamemodify("./.repro", ":p")

-- Set stdpaths to use .repro
for _, name in ipairs({ "config", "data", "state", "cache" }) do
	vim.env[("XDG_%s_HOME"):format(name:upper())] = root .. "/" .. name
end
vim.o.swapfile = false

vim.lsp.config("lua_ls", {
	cmd = { "lua-language-server" },
	filetypes = { "lua" },
	root_markers = { ".luarc.json" },
	settings = { Lua = { codeLens = { enable = true } } },
})
vim.lsp.enable("lua_ls")
vim.lsp.codelens.enable(true)

-- From `:h LspProgress`.
vim.api.nvim_create_autocmd("LspProgress", {
	callback = function(ev)
		local value = ev.data.params.value
		vim.api.nvim_echo({ { value.message or "done" } }, false, {
			id = "lsp." .. ev.data.params.token,
			kind = "progress",
			source = "vim.lsp",
			title = value.title,
			status = value.kind ~= "end" and "running" or "success",
			percent = value.percentage,
		})
	end,
})

if CANCEL then
	vim.api.nvim_create_autocmd({ "TextChanged", "TextChangedI", "TextChangedP" }, {
		callback = function(ev)
			for _, client in ipairs(vim.lsp.get_clients({ bufnr = ev.buf })) do
				for id, request in pairs(client.requests) do
					if
						request.type == "pending"
						and request.bufnr == ev.buf
						and request.method == "codeLens/resolve"
					then
						client:cancel_request(id)
					end
				end
			end
		end,
	})
end

-- Statusline counters:
-- - resolve: codeLens/resolve requests in flight now (most at once) / sent in total
-- - searches: LuaLS "Searching in files..." progress running now (most at once) / started in total
local stats = { pending = 0, max_pending = 0, sent = 0, searches = {}, running = 0, max_running = 0, started = 0 }

vim.api.nvim_create_autocmd("LspRequest", {
	callback = function(ev)
		local request = ev.data.request
		if request.method ~= "codeLens/resolve" then return end
		if request.type == "pending" then stats.sent = stats.sent + 1 end
		local client = assert(vim.lsp.get_client_by_id(ev.data.client_id))
		local pending = 0
		for _, r in pairs(client.requests) do
			if r.type == "pending" and r.method == "codeLens/resolve" then pending = pending + 1 end
		end
		stats.pending, stats.max_pending = pending, math.max(stats.max_pending, pending)
		vim.cmd.redrawstatus()
	end,
})

vim.api.nvim_create_autocmd("LspProgress", {
	callback = function(ev)
		local token, value = ev.data.params.token, ev.data.params.value
		if value.kind == "begin" and value.title == "Searching in files..." then
			stats.searches[token] = true
			stats.started = stats.started + 1
		elseif value.kind == "end" then
			stats.searches[token] = nil
		end
		stats.running = vim.tbl_count(stats.searches)
		stats.max_running = math.max(stats.max_running, stats.running)
		vim.cmd.redrawstatus()
	end,
})

function _G.codelens_stats()
	return ("resolve: %d (max %d) / %d   searches: %d (max %d) / %d%s"):format(
		stats.pending,
		stats.max_pending,
		stats.sent,
		stats.running,
		stats.max_running,
		stats.started,
		CANCEL and "   [CANCEL]" or ""
	)
end
vim.o.laststatus = 2
vim.o.statusline = "%f%=%{v:lua.codelens_stats()}"
```

```lua
-- Generates the Lua project under ./project: `nvim -l gen.lua`
--
-- Every module defines the same field functions, so resolving a reference code lens on one of them
-- makes LuaLS search every file in the workspace.
local MODULES = 300
local NAMES = {
	"setup", "config", "opts", "init", "run", "start", "stop", "get", "set", "build",
	"open", "close", "read", "write", "parse", "render", "update", "reset", "load", "save",
}

local function write(path, lines)
	vim.fn.mkdir(vim.fs.dirname(path), "p")
	local f = assert(io.open(path, "w"))
	f:write(table.concat(lines, "\n"), "\n")
	f:close()
end

local function module_lines(next_module)
	local lines = { "local M = {}", "" }
	for _, name in ipairs(NAMES) do
		lines[#lines + 1] = ("M.%s = function(...) return ... end"):format(name)
	end
	lines[#lines + 1] = ""
	lines[#lines + 1] = "function M.chain()"
	for _, name in ipairs(NAMES) do
		lines[#lines + 1] = ('\trequire("%s").%s(M.%s())'):format(next_module, name, name)
	end
	lines[#lines + 1] = "end"
	lines[#lines + 1] = ""
	lines[#lines + 1] = "return M"
	return lines
end

vim.fn.delete("project", "rf")
write("project/.luarc.json", {
	"{",
	'  "runtime.version": "LuaJIT",',
	'  "runtime.path": ["lua/?.lua", "lua/?/init.lua"],',
	'  "diagnostics.workspaceDelay": -1',
	"}",
})
for i = 1, MODULES do
	local next_module = ("mods.mod_%03d"):format(i % MODULES + 1)
	write(("project/lua/mods/mod_%03d.lua"):format(i), module_lines(next_module))
end
-- The file to edit: one code lens per line.
write("project/main.lua", module_lines("mods.mod_001"))
```


### Expected behavior

Neovim cancels `codeLens/resolve` requests when their responses become stale, like it does for semantic tokens and pull diagnostics.

### Nvim version (nvim -v)

v0.13.0-dev-1963+g9290926ccf

### Language server name/version

lua-language-server 3.19.2

### Operating system/version

macOS 27

_No response_
